excerpt: 101 tons of gallium trichloride-hydrochloric acid solution, containing 30.3 tons of gallium; GALLEX operated 1991-1997, GNO continued May 1998-April 2003; capture rate 73.1 SNU (GALLEX), 62.9 SNU (GNO); led by MPIK Heidelberg with French, German, Italian, Israeli, Polish and American scientists.
title: GALLEX
